messages:
nina: Quick shout  Arcadia Labs is live on Azure Marketplace using Redwood Dedicated for inference. Went production this morning. :tada:

omar: Nice! any smoke test numbers?

nina: Smoke: 33% faster rerank latency and ~1.9x embedding throughput after switching to our int8 quant variant + prefix cache. They reserved a dedicated pool in eu-west-2.

dina: Great win. Marketing  please grab a 1-2 sentence customer quote + a short tech blurb for the marketplace spotlight.

kevin: Ops note: Arcadia requested BYOK and 180-day audit log retention. Ticket INF-4901 created. Also enabled VPC peering and KMS rotation schedule.

pm-bot: Azure Marketplace listing published: https://portal.azure.com/marketplace/items/arcadia/embed-suite status=ACTIVE.

legal: Agreement AG-10011 signed. Please send consent form for quote.

nina: I'll schedule a 15-min quote call with their CTO tomorrow at 10am BST and attach consent.

omar: Tiny engineering snippet for the blog:

```
redwood.reserve_capacity(
  customer="arcadia",
  pool="dedicated-eu-west-2",
  instances=6,
  model="embed-pro-3b",
  quant_variant="int8-v2",
  cache_prefixing=true
)
```

dina: Sales: please add Arcadia to reference list (Ref ID: REF-ARC-14).

kevin: Observability ticket SRE-2433 created to add per-route latency dashboard and 30-day trace retention.

nina: Marketing will share draft social + marketplace blurb by EOD. Congrats team! :rocket:
